protocol: Each score gives every tag a noise from the labels of its fitting products, and tags are sorted from least to most noisy with ties to the larger tag and then the tag name. Spread is the mean distance of a tag's labels to their medoid when labels that first differ at digit k are q to the power minus k apart. The shrunk spread adds one pseudo-product at the spread of all fitting labels. Pairwise is the mean distance between two different products of the tag. Ball is the number of leading digits on which the stated share of a tag's labels agree, longest first, with ties to the smaller spread at weight 71. Entropy is the Shannon entropy of the exact labels. Each order is fitted as a priority list with cell medoids, backfilled cell medoids and pooled values, with cells fitted at weight 71 and at weight 2. Taxonomy association is refitted as the reference and must equal the order by spread under the discrete metric. Folds have equal weight.
